title: Traditional Ukrainian Pork Roast
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian-inspired dish, perfect for a cold winter night. The combination of tender pork and flaky crust will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Season the pork roast with salt, black pepper, and your favorite seasonings.
In a separate bowl, mix 1/4 cup of self-rising flour and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme.
Roll out the flour mixture into a thin sheet, large enough to cover the pork roast.
Place the pork roast in the center of the flour sheet and wrap it tightly.
Place the wrapped pork roast in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Remove the pork roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
